"# Walkthrough - Pro Feature warning modal in Lite Mode

We have resolved the missing warning modal issue in the Lite mode on the main page of the MVP.

## Changes Made

### Frontend Changes

#### [index.html](file:///c:/Users/Зефирка/StartUp/index.html)
- Added the missing `pro-feature-modal` HTML element.
- Verified that styling matches the premium glassmorphic dark-theme design.
- Integrated the transitions and event listeners so that:
  - In Lite Mode, when clicking on any restricted professional module, the warning modal appears with a smooth transition.
  - The modal allows returning to Lite mode or upgrading to Pro Mode.
  - Clicking "Включить режим Pro" switches the system context to Pro mode and successfully redirects the user to their target module.

## Verification & Testing Results

### Manual Verification
1. Opened the MVP dashboard with `currentProductMode = 'lite'`.
2. Hiding of all sidebar categories in Lite mode was verified (only the Home module is active).
3. Clicking on bottom cards ("Мониторинг метрик", "Сквозной полный прогон", "Верификация ордеров", "Обучение RL-агентов") was verified to correctly trigger the `pro-feature-modal` overlay.
4. The transitions (fade-in, scale-up) were verified to execute cleanly.
5. "Остаться в Lite" click handler was verified to fade out and hide the modal.
6. "Включить режим Pro" click handler was verified to switch the sidebar categories to visible, toggle the mode switch to Pro, and immediately load the clicked module workspace.
"
